description: 对话练习：Story time + Cartoon time 完整内容，角色扮演跟读

sections.title: Story time — What can we do to go green?

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.english: Earth is our home. We should protect the Earth.
lines.chinese: 地球是我们的家园。我们应该保护地球。

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.english: What can we do to go green?
lines.chinese: 我们能做些什么来践行绿色生活？

lines.speaker: Class
lines.english: Save water!
lines.chinese: 节约用水！

lines.speaker: Class
lines.english: Turn off the tap when you brush your teeth. Don't waste water.
lines.chinese: 刷牙时关掉水龙头。不要浪费水。

lines.speaker: Class
lines.english: Save electricity!
lines.chinese: 节约用电！

lines.speaker: Class
lines.english: Turn off lights when you leave the room. Don't waste electricity.
lines.chinese: 离开房间时关灯。不要浪费电。

lines.speaker: Class
lines.english: Don't waste food!
lines.chinese: 不要浪费食物！

lines.speaker: Class
lines.english: Eat up your food. Don't waste food.
lines.chinese: 把食物吃光。不要浪费食物。

lines.speaker: Class
lines.english: Save paper!
lines.chinese: 节约用纸！

lines.speaker: Class
lines.english: Use both sides of the paper. Don't waste paper.
lines.chinese: 使用纸的两面。不要浪费纸。

lines.speaker: Class
lines.english: Use cloth bags! Don't use too many plastic bags.
lines.chinese: 使用布袋！不要使用太多塑料袋。

lines.speaker: Class
lines.english: Take part in Earth Hour!
lines.chinese: 参加地球一小时！

sections.title: Cartoon time — A poster for Earth Day

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: Bobby, Sam and their friends are doing a project for Earth Day.
lines.chinese: Bobby、Sam和他们的朋友们正在做一个地球日的项目。

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: The Earth is our home. What can we do to help it?
lines.chinese: 地球是我们的家园。我们能做些什么来帮助它呢？

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: Let's make a poster about it. Will you join me?
lines.chinese: 我们来做一张关于它的海报吧。你愿意加入我吗？

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.english: OK!
lines.chinese: 好的！

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: Will you draw or write on the poster, Sam?
lines.chinese: Sam，你要在海报上画画还是写字？

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.english: I'll draw the Earth and colour it green and blue.
lines.chinese: 我要画地球，把它涂成绿色和蓝色。

lines.speaker: Billy
lines.english: I'll draw a rubbish bin.
lines.chinese: 我要画一个垃圾桶。

lines.speaker: Willy
lines.english: I'll write "Reduce, reuse and recycle!"
lines.chinese: 我要写「减少、再利用、回收利用！」

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: Now it's my turn! I'll draw some banana trees. I like bananas.
lines.chinese: 现在轮到我了！我要画一些香蕉树。我喜欢香蕉。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.english: Er... Bobby, that's not right.
lines.chinese: 呃……Bobby，这不对吧。

lines.speaker: Billy
lines.english: It's for your banana skins!
lines.chinese: 这是给你扔香蕉皮用的！

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: Oh, right. I'm sorry.
lines.chinese: 哦，对哦。对不起。

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: I'll help protect the Earth. I won't throw banana skins on the ground any more.
lines.chinese: 我会帮助保护地球。我再也不会把香蕉皮扔在地上了。

lines.speaker: All
lines.english: Great! Our poster is ready!
lines.chinese: 太棒了！我们的海报做好了！

lines.speaker: All
lines.english: Happy Earth Day!
lines.chinese: 地球日快乐！
